$comment: Shared requirement-tag vocabulary. Read by UI/src/config/requirementTags.ts and (step F4) backend/campus/registration/keys.py. Parsing lives only in 'cells'; do not add logic in either language.

NORMALISE (identical in both languages, nothing else): (1) trim leading/trailing whitespace; (2) collapse every run of whitespace to a single space; (3) remove all whitespace directly after a colon, so 'GE: 3B+US23' and 'GE:3B+US23' both become 'GE:3B+US23'. No case folding, no other edits. Look the result up in 'cells'.
Unknown cells map to []. The caller always keeps the raw string. Never guess.

Judgement calls: 'GE: UD 2/5' gives both GE:UD2 and GE:UD5 (decision 11). 'GE: 1Bor4' gives GE:1B and GE:4. 'GE: Area 4' is GE:4. 'GE: E' is the legacy area E (LGE:E). 'GE: 4+US' (bare US, 4 rows in Fall 2026) gives GE:4 only: bare 'US' does not say which of US1/US2/US3 and is not tagged. 'GE: 4+US23' gives GE:4, AI:US2, AI:US3. 'GE: WID+3' gives WID and GE:3. 'PE: PhysEd' is PE. The 'AI:' prefix is American Institutions. Cal-GETC area 7 never appears in Fall 2026 and is not defined. Only legacy area E appears; add other legacy areas only when seen.
The 31 cells below are the distinct Satisfies spellings measured on the Fall 2026 schedule (F1).
